text.p: Close of play scores on the opening day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Wednesday:
At Liverpool: Glamorgan 173-1 (S.James 99 not out) v Lancashire.
At Bristol: Middlesex 237 all out (K.Dutch 79, M.Ramprakash 75; A.Smith 5-23). Gloucestershire 57-3.
At Worcester: Surrey 382-7 (J.Ratcliffe 135, A.Brown 121) v Worcestershire.
At Bath: Leicestershire 337-3 (I.Sutcliffe 112, J.Whitaker 78 not out, V.Wells 70, D.Maddy 58) v Somerset.
At Trent Bridge: Yorkshire 364 all out (D.Byas 128, D.Lehmann 62, M.Moxon 60; K.Evans 6-91). Nottinghamshire 5-0.
At Darlington: Durham 215-7 (J.Lewis 129 not out) v Kent.
At Northampton: Hampshire 335-4 (M.Hayden 150, R.Smith 71 not out, D.James 56) v Northamptonshire.
